headline: Committee on the Status Of Women

meeting.body: Committee on the Status Of Women
meeting.summary: The committee heard from the county Director of Human Concerns and voted to combine its Women of Excellence event with its July 2027 women's conference.
meeting.recap: Four members were present, so the committee had quorum.[[0:01:52]] The county Director of Human Concerns was the guest speaker.[[0:02:31]] She said about a third of county households with children under 18 have a single parent, and these are disproportionately led by women.[[0:05:21]] The director said the county set aside $12 million for income support, with United Way, for households earning too much for public aid but too little to survive.[[0:30:58]] The committee approved its June 16 minutes by unanimous vote.[[0:37:04]] The committee sponsored its women's conference with a little over $5,000.[[0:41:33]] Fire survivors were invited to attend the conference for free.[[0:42:56]] The committee voted to combine its Women of Excellence event with the women's conference planned for July 2027.[[0:53:37]] A member said the trauma-informed care trainees will present to more providers on the Big Island in August.[[0:55:38]] Members were asked to help at a boards and commissions table at the fair, October 1 through 4.[[0:57:57]] The next meeting is August 18 at 12:00.[[1:01:35]]
decided: The committee approved the June 16, 2026 minutes by unanimous vote.
The committee voted to combine the Women of Excellence event with the women's conference planned for July 2027.
meeting.next: The report on the state commission will wait until next month, when the ex officio member is back. The chair said the public health conference presentation will be sent to members for the August meeting. The chair said video from the women's conference will be shared at or before the August meeting. The chair said another women's conference is in the committee's budget. The chair said she would be happy to have the director of an organization that helps moms and babies present next month if there is room. Members will choose a new chair and vice chair in March or April.
